short: The summary return where GST liability is declared and paid.
seoTitle: GSTR-3B — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: The summary return where GST liability is declared and paid. Unlike GSTR-1 it is summarised rather than invoice-wise. Part of the free Setu business glossary.
definition: GSTR-3B is the periodic summary return that declares total outward supplies, input tax credit claimed and tax payable, and through which the payment is actually made. Unlike GSTR-1 it is summarised rather than invoice-wise.
bodyHtml:
Why GSTR-3B matters

GSTR-3B is where money leaves your account, and the figures in it are matched against GSTR-1 and your auto-drafted credit statement. Persistent mismatches are one of the fastest routes to a notice.

How GSTR-3B works in practice

Reconcile three numbers before filing: sales as billed, sales as reported in GSTR-1, and credit as available in GSTR-2B. Doing this monthly turns a year-end reconciliation project into a ten-minute check.

faq.question: Do I file both GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B?
faq.answer: Yes. GSTR-1 reports invoice details, GSTR-3B declares and pays the summarised liability for the period.

faq.question: What happens if GSTR-3B is filed late?
faq.answer: Late fees accrue per day and interest applies on the unpaid tax, and subsequent filings can be blocked until the backlog is cleared.
